intro.lede: Paste your Google Maps link. We read every single one of your reviews and hand you a one-page honest summary: your satisfaction score, the topics that keep coming up, and the one concrete step you can take this week.

input.label: Google Maps business link
input.demo: Try it with a sample business →
input.hint: Open your business on Google Maps, hit “Share”, copy the link and paste it here.
input.err: That doesn't look like a Google Maps link. Open your business on Google Maps, tap “Share”, copy the link and paste it here.

step1.d: The link to your Google Maps business page is all we need. Nothing to install, nothing to connect.

step2.d: We pull down your recent reviews, read every one and separate the praise, the complaints and the recurring topics.

step3.d: One page: your score, the topics that repeat, and one concrete step for this week. No dashboard, no chart overload.

get1.d: One number out of 100, plus the tone split.

get2.d: The most repeated praise and complaints, with how many reviews mention each.

get3.d: We won't tell you to “fix everything”. Just one step you can take this week.

assure.text: We don't edit your reviews, we don't delete them, we don't polish them. We read all of them and tell you the way someone would say it to your face.

float.note: “Waiting during lunch hours” appears in 31 reviews.

load.foot: Your reviews stay exactly as they are; we only read and summarise them. We don't ask for an email for this preview.

themes.h: The topics that keep coming up

lock.h: Your report is ready — let's open the rest.
lock.p: The score and tone split are above. The recurring topics and the concrete suggestion live in the full report. Leave your email and we'll unlock everything.
lock.note: No ads, no bulk mail. Just this report and, if you want, one update a month.
lock.err: Please enter a valid email address.
lock.donet: Your full report is open below. A copy is on its way to {e}.
lock.donetMock: Your full report is open below. (No copy was emailed because the email service is not connected.)

act.k: The one step to take this week

method.t: The score is calculated from review volume, rating distribution and the weight of recurring topics. We never edit, delete or buy reviews. Quotes are shortened from real reviews.

foot.tagline: An honest summary of your reviews, made for small businesses.

a.d: Your customers have taken ownership of you. At this level the job is to not break what's working and to turn satisfaction into new customers.

b.d: There's a solid foundation here. Two small touches will move this visibly upward — you'll see which topic in the full report.

c.d: Not bad, but one single topic is dragging your score down. Touch that and the difference shows fast.

d.d: There's a problem piling up here. The good news: the most repeated topic is very clear, so you know exactly where to start.
